topics.topic: Whether prior approval remains valid when non-input request-forming metadata/determinants change
questions: If other request determinants change (e.g., manifest required headers, credential header reference/value) while inputs and api_base_url stay the same, does the prior approval still cover the send?
If other request-forming metadata changes after restart (required headers, credential header name/value, instance class/TLS allowance), does an existing approval still cover the send?

topics.topic: Admission comparison semantics for `many` file outputs (cardinality/order/identity)
questions: How are expected vs actual outputs compared for a `many` file output port in admission (count, ordering, per-element identity)?

topics.topic: Behavior when `try` references a non-existent implementation id
questions: What exactly happens when the requested implementation does not exist?

topics.topic: Data model stored in `TrialExecution.outputs` for file-producing trial executions
questions: When a trial execution produces a file output, what exact data model is written in `TrialExecution.outputs`?

topics.topic: Definition of guard-port 'closed set' schemas and guard value equality semantics
questions: Which schema forms count as a 'closed set' for guard ports, and what equality semantics are used for matching guard values?

topics.topic: Exact scope of rule-5 checks re-run at send time as 'of the record itself'
questions: Exactly which rule-5 checks are considered "of the record itself" during invocation re-check, especially checks that also depend on binding ports (idempotency-key fields and request-shape fit)?

topics.topic: Final handling of pre-existing `unknown` EffectAttempt when run ends `refused`/`failed`
questions: If a run ends `refused` or `failed` while another element already has an `unknown` EffectAttempt, what final handling is required for that attempt?

topics.topic: Mapped node aggregate conclusion when some mapped elements end in non-success/non-failure states (e.g., `upstream_failed`)
questions: If one mapped element concludes `upstream_failed` (or another non-succeeded, non-failed status), what is the mapped node's aggregate conclusion for dependants?

topics.topic: Meaning of phase-9 'reaches' (pure graph reachability vs guard-aware reachability)
questions: Is 'reaches' purely structural graph reachability, or must it account for guard conditions (and if so, how)?

topics.topic: Precedence of purpose-consistency check relative to other request validations
questions: Does the slot/flow purpose-consistency check run literally before all checks (including schema/token), or only before other operation-specific checks?

topics.topic: Required error detail when send-time pre-send checks fail due to stale/non-invocable binding
questions: When pre-send checks fail because the binding/manifest is stale or no longer invocable, must the detail always be `binding_stale`, or must it name the specific failed check?

topics.topic: Required ordering semantics for `map_index` on resume
questions: What exact ordering must be used for `map_index` values (numeric ascending, lexical, or store order)?

topics.topic: Scope of rejecting caller-supplied computed identities (creation only vs any request field/reference)
questions: Is this refusal only for create/author submissions (where the kernel must compute identity), or for any request field that contains these ids, including references to existing records (e.g., activate/run by flow_version_id)?

topics.topic: Whether 2xx response bodies are ignored or must be valid JSON when a non-file binding has zero output ports
questions: For a non-file binding with zero output ports, must a 2xx body still be valid JSON, or is it fully ignored?

topics.topic: Whether trial-case input/expected_output ports must exactly match declared ports or may be subsets
questions: Must trial-case inputs/expected_outputs be exact port sets (all required ports present, no extras), or are subsets allowed?
